Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.LocationIndiaAbout The RoleThe Partner Success Manager is accountable for helping Kinaxis value added reseller (VAR) partners build productive, scalable, and predictable businesses around Kinaxis solutions. The role connects partner enablement, operating discipline, pipeline governance, and alliance management so that partners are equipped to create demand, progress opportunities, close business, and deliver a consistent customer experience.This is a hands-on orchestration role. The Partner Success Manager works across VAR leadership, partner sellers and solution consultants, Kinaxis sales, pre-sales, marketing, services, customer success, operations, and legal teams. The successful candidate combines strong partner relationships with rigorous execution and uses data to identify risks, remove barriers, and improve partner performance.What you will do Develop and manage role-based partner enablement, onboarding, certification, product training, and ongoing knowledge programs. Assess partner capabilities, identify readiness gaps, and drive remediation plans with clear milestones and ownership. Ensure partners can effectively position Kinaxis solutions, qualify opportunities, and leverage Kinaxis resources. Drive adoption of approved tools, processes, programs, and new product/solution launches. Establish and improve partner delivery readiness and standards to ensure consistent implementation quality and customer outcomes. Manage partner operations, governance, business reviews, pipeline cadence, scorecards, records, approvals, and action tracking. Partner with VAR sales leaders to build account plans, campaigns, qualified pipeline, and revenue opportunities. Lead pipeline reviews, monitor opportunity progression and CRM hygiene, and coordinate internal resources to advance priority deals. Analyze pipeline and sales performance metrics to identify risks and drive corrective actions. Build strong executive and functional relationships and develop joint business plans with partners. Align Kinaxis and partner stakeholders on priorities, responsibilities, investments, and execution. Identify opportunities to expand partner capabilities, market coverage, industry reach, and geographic presence. Represent partner needs internally while balancing customer outcomes and Kinaxis business priorities. Education Qualification Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience. What we are looking for 5+ years of experience in partner management, channel sales or partner operations. Experience working with VARs, system integrators, software partners, or indirect go-to-market models. Strong understanding of enterprise software sales cycles, pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, and partner economics. Ability to translate strategy into actionable plans, measurable milestones, and effective execution across stakeholders. Strong relationship management, communication, presentation, facilitation, and executive engagement skills. Strong analytical capabilities with proficiency in CRM, reporting, collaboration, and productivity tools. Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions and functions with sound judgment and attention to detail. Preferred: Experience in supply chain planning, SaaS, enterprise applications, or digital transformation. Preferred: Experience managing global/multi-regional partner portfolios, partner enablement, certifications, demand generation, channel programs, or complex co-sell models. #Intermediate, #Senior Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. title: Director, Salesforce Program Leader
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
As an Engagement Delivery Director, you are a senior individual contributor and a foremost expert in delivering intended business value from the Salesforce platform. This is a fully-billable, high-impact role deployed as a Delivery Leader to our strategic and complex customer engagements.
  
  
You will be responsible for the end-to-end success of programs, with a primary focus on maximizing platform adoption, demonstrating ROI, and mitigating revenue or license attrition risk. You will ensure that emerging capabilities, including agentic and generative AI programs, are delivered on time, within budget, and with a strict focus on quantifiable business outcomes.
  
  
You will act as the key strategic advisor and point of accountability, building trust with executive stakeholders and ensuring the customer's long-term success on the platform.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Program Accountability: Assume ultimate accountability for establishing, executing and overseeing program governance to deliver strategic value-realization and recovery plans for strategic customer accounts, ensuring clear governance frameworks for complex multi-cloud and enterprise AI implementation roadmaps.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Engage directly with C-level stakeholders to build trust, define success metrics, and demonstrate measurable platform ROI. You will lead all executive stakeholder forums, like Steering Committees, focusing heavily on Performance Evaluation & ROI to help customers quantify the financial and operational business value of their AI investments.
* Strategic Advisory: Serve as the primary, billable expert providing strategic oversight to ensure program delivery aligns with the customer's core business objectives.
* Risk & Scope Management: Proactively identify, assess, and manage program risks, dependencies, and scope changes. You will own the executive-level escalation process and translate complex technical issues—such as AI compliance, data readiness, and security boundaries—into clear business implications.
* Commercial Acumen: Lead and support pre-sales teams in initial scoping, change management, and identifying opportunities for expansion of the running program, accurately sizing the organizational change management and delivery effort required for generative AI and digital agent rollouts.
* Delivery Governance: Define, structure, and oversee complex engagement models (e.g., T&M, Fixed Price), ensuring all delivery commitments, milestones, and scope are meticulously managed. You will champion an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology from a management perspective, tracking program health, team velocity, and delivery efficiency.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Provide expert guidance and strategic direction to customer, partner (SI), and internal teams (e.g., MuleSoft, UI/UX, technical PODs) to ensure cohesive and successful program outcomes.
* Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a deep subject matter expert on the Salesforce platform, including new products, industry trends, and best-practice implementation strategies involving custom development, integration, and data migration.
* Contract Management: Prior experience in understanding and working with MSA/SOW and ensuring delivery is compliant to the terms laid out there.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Experience: 15+ years of experience, predominantly in consulting or strategic advisory roles, managing large-scale, complex SaaS/CRM program implementations.
* Platform Expertise: Deep expertise in the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including common implementation patterns, integration challenges, custom development, and data migration strategies, and foundational understanding of Agentforce use cases and data cloud dependencies.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to build C-level relationships, navigate difficult conversations, and negotiate high-stakes outcomes.
* Account Recovery: Proven experience in strategic account recovery, risk mitigation, and driving platform adoption in complex, at-risk customer environments.
* Cross-cultural experience: Must have prior experience working in a multi-cultural environment with teams and stakeholders geographically spread.
* Team management: Prior experience leading the program pre-sales & delivery team by fostering continuous learning and ensuring members are well-trained, while supporting and driving career growth, personal and team development, well-being, diversity, and inclusion.
* Methodology: Demonstrated mastery of program management methodologies (Agile, Hybrid) and the ability to apply them to complex enterprise environments, including adapting agile frameworks to support the iterative testing and validation loops unique to generative AI solutions.
* Mindset: A self-starting, individual contributor mindset with the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and influence across matrixed organizations.
* Leadership: Ability to lead a team of consultants in a matrix environment towards a common goal while navigating customer & internal organizational landscape.
* Education: Degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* Certifications: Must have at least either of these Project management certification (PMI-ACP / PMP / PgMP / Prince 2) and having Salesforce Certification is an asset. An AI Associate or related AI/ML delivery credential is highly valued.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Manager - Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - SAP FICO/SD with DRC E-Invoicing & E-Reporting - Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Mumbai/Pune/Gurugram/Chennai/Kolkata
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager, Tax Services**
**– Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) -**
**SAP FICO/SD - DRC E-Invoicing E-Reporting**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support US-based clients as they modernize and strengthen their tax functions through SAP-enabled transformation. This role sits within Tax Transformation Consulting and focuses on SAP FICO/SD integration and SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) capabilities supporting e-invoicing, e-reporting, and digital compliance requirements. You will work across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to help design and deliver scalable compliance solutions in complex ERP environments.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.
* People Development: Perform role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology-enabled, cutting-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 8 to 15+ years of total experience.
* 5+ years of Implementation experience in SAP ECC 6.0 & S4 HANA with focus on Tax integration with SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with direct or indirect tax experience.
* Experience with design and implement SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) solutions that support global e-invoicing, statutory reporting, and digital compliance requirements. Experience of working across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable SAP-based compliance capabilities across complex ERP environments. Ability to translate country-specific statutory and e-invoicing requirements into functional specifications, solution designs, and testing scenarios.
* Expert in Direct and Indirect Tax configuration, Withholding Taxes, local country indirect tax localizations, VAT customizations and Reporting.
* Experience with User Exits, preparing functional specifications, executing test cycles, cutovers, go-live and Hypercare, providing user training and documentation.
* Expert in cross functional integration of modules - SD-FI & MM-FI
* Strong in project management, leadership abilities, and has tendency to independently execute project cycles and deliverables.
* Relentless focus on quality of work products while adhering to completing deliverables on time.
* Effective communications and strong presentation and team building skills. Initiative-taking participates in firm-based activities and owns his/her career.
* Strong analytical skills in business process design and requirements preparation

Preferred:
  
  

* SAP MM or SD (ECC or S4 HANA) Certified
* Experience with tax technology applications i.e., ONESOURCE /Global NEXT Integration, Vertex/Accelerator & Chain flow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, Sovos
* Central Finance with Tax integration, Transfer Pricing, BRIM
* Experience with New GL, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Intercompany, Materials Management, Logistics Invoice Verification, Asset Accounting implementation.
* Experience with Ariba, Coupa, Hybris, Open Text, Read soft Integration with ERP.

* Commercial & Sales Support
* Partner with sales teams to attend technical client meetings and site visit.
* Draft technical portions of commercial rental proposals.
* Generate accurate cost estimations for labor and materials.
* Deliver technical presentations to corporate decision-makers.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. title: Customer Success Engineer (SaaS) | Pune Onsite
description:
**About BotSpace**

BotSpace builds AI agents for e-commerce brands. They help brands sell more and handle customer support across their website, WhatsApp, Instagram and other channels. We work with fast-growing D2C and Shopify brands and are building an AI-native platform for sales, support and customer engagement.

**The role**

This is a customer role for an engineer. You'll own a group of BotSpace customers from the day they sign: get them live, learn how their business runs, find what stops them getting value from BotSpace and solve it. Sometimes that's configuration. Sometimes it's a script or an integration with the rest of their stack. Sometimes it's a bug you've narrowed down so well that our engineers can fix it the same day.

Elsewhere this job is called a forward-deployed engineer, implementation engineer or technical account manager. It isn't a pure development role: most of your week is spent with customers, and the code you write is in service of them.

**What you'll do**

* Onboard new brands: WhatsApp Business API setup, Meta verification and message templates, Shopify and other integrations, their first automations and their AI agent
* Own the relationship with your accounts on calls, WhatsApp and email, and review with them regularly what's working and what isn't
* Debug customer issues end to end: read the logs, check API responses and webhooks, reproduce the problem, then fix it or give engineering a bug report they can act on
* Build what a customer needs on top of the product: API and webhook integrations, small scripts, data imports, custom flows
* Notice early when an account is at risk, and when one is ready to do more with us
* Bring patterns back to the product team: repeat issues, missing features, rough edges in onboarding
* Write the docs and playbooks that help the next customer go live faster

**What we're looking for**

* A software engineer by training: B.E. or B.Tech in computer science or IT, MCA, or real hands-on coding experience
* 2 or more years in a customer-facing technical role at a software company: technical support, application support, implementation, solutions or customer success engineering
* You can read code and write some: JavaScript or Python scripts, REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, SQL or MongoDB queries
* You debug methodically and can explain what broke to a non-technical founder in plain words
* Clear spoken and written English, comfortable on calls with founders and operations teams
* You follow through. When a customer is waiting on something, they hear from you before they have to ask

**A major plus**

* Hands-on time with the WhatsApp Business API, Meta Business Manager or a messaging platform such as Gupshup, Twilio, Wati or Interakt
* Shopify: the admin, apps, webhooks and how D2C brands run their stores
* Helpdesk and CRM tools such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, Gorgias or HubSpot
* You've set up or tuned an LLM-based product: prompts, knowledge bases, AI agents
* A stint as a developer before you moved into support or implementation

**How success is measured**

* New customers go live quickly and actually use what they bought
* The accounts you own renew and grow
* Problems get fixed at the root, so the same issue doesn't come back
* Engineering can act on your bug reports without a follow-up call

**The pace**

This is a high-intensity, high-performance role. Our customers move fast, the targets are clear and you own the outcome. If that sounds good to you, you'll fit in well here.

**Why join BotSpace**

You'll sit between our customers and our engineering team and work closely with the founders. You'll see how hundreds of brands use the product day to day, and what you learn goes straight into what we build next.

**How to apply**

Apply on our careers site. It takes about twenty minutes: a short form with your resume and LinkedIn, then 4 quick questions with our hiring assistant. We read every application and reply within a week.

title: Sr Team Manager - BB, BM RM Managed Mgt Support
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Descriptor**
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through Business Banking, our international network offers comprehensive support and services to small and medium-sized businesses. From expanding overseas to managing the cash and trade flows of an established enterprise, the Business Banking team of relationship managers and product specialists provides a range of end-to-end solutions designed to help businesses reach their potential.
  
  
**Business Banking**
At HSBC, we recognize that India is not just a rapidly growing economy; it’s a diverse SME landscape known for its rich cultural heritage, technology innovation, and agricultural strength. As you navigate the complexities of today’s business landscape , HSBC Business Banking can help provide market-leading capabilities and solutions, along with the intelligence and confidence to adapt swiftly, act decisively, and operate with agility. Through Business Banking, we offer comprehensive product suits to meet the need of growing small and mid-size business in India. From raising short term working capital as well as long term growth aspirations, simple or complex trade finance, complex cash management and digital solutions or expanding overseas to managing the cash and trade flows of an established enterprise, the Business Banking team of Relationship Managers and Product Specialists provides a range of end-to end solutions designed to help small and large businesses reach their potential.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the Business Banking team as Team Leader.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* The jobholder will lead, coach, manage and develop a team of Business Banking RMs to deliver bespoke strategic objectives to acquire, retain, and grow International SME Commercial Banking (CMB) customer relationships for HSBC
* To participate in strategic decisions to drive the BB business forward, with a strong focus on high value, quality domestic and international customers and prospects.
* To drive best practice in lending and risk policies ensuring this remains in line with economic and market practices.
* Owning customer engagement, ensuring service excellence at all times, for all aspects of any customer, prospect or professional’s interaction with HSBC and to improve customer engagement.
* Optimising the potential value and profitability of existing relationships by assisting in the delivery of solutions, products and services appropriate to meet customer need.
* Maintaining credit quality and leading a high performing team of business banking relationship managers and support managers.

**Qualifications**

* Graduate /Post graduate with at least 8-10 years of relevant experience of lending in Commercial Banking.
* Driving a high performance culture across the team delivering customer and financial objectives.
* Driving digital product penetration and cross sell to existing and new customers.

**Pro-Tip:**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.
  
  
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: VP - BA Client Journey Execution
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as a VP – BA Client Journey Execution, where you will support the organisation in delivering its strategic objectives through the identification, definition, and delivery of business requirements and solutions that address complex business problems and opportunities.
  
  
In this role, you will work in close partnership with Product Owners and Technology teams to shape and deliver market‑leading digital products and client journeys, ensuring solutions are customer‑centric, scalable, and aligned to regulatory, operational, and strategic priorities. You will play a key role in driving the end‑to‑end onboarding and KYC journey, ensuring efficient execution, strong stakeholder alignment, and pace of delivery across complex change initiatives.
  
  
**Key Critical Skills Include**

* Proven experience as a Business Analyst, ideally within financial services or regulated environments.
* Demonstrated experience working closely with Product Owners within Agile delivery models to implement market‑leading digital products and client journeys.
* Strong understanding of end‑to‑end client onboarding journeys, with KYC knowledge considered highly desirable.
* Formal change methodology qualifications, such as Agile Practitioner, Lean, and/or Six Sigma.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively across business, product, operations, compliance, and technology teams.
* A proven track record of delivering complex programmes at pace, managing ambiguity while maintaining delivery discipline and high-quality outcomes.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:

You will partner closely with License Sales, Pre-Sales, and Professional Services Delivery teams to position Professional Services as a strategic component of the overall solution. title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Home Mantra is a real estate agency based in Wakad, Pune, supporting professionals, families, and investors in making informed property decisions across the Pune district. The company specializes in residential and commercial property sales, rental and leasing solutions, and investment consulting in Pune’s growing real estate market. Home Mantra provides end-to-end support, from property search through documentation, ensuring a smooth and reliable experience. With strong local market expertise, a focus on transparency, and personalized service, the team is committed to helping clients find not just properties, but real homes and long-term investments.

**Role Description**
The Relationship Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in the Pune District. This role involves managing and nurturing client relationships, understanding client requirements, and recommending suitable residential or commercial properties and investment options. The Relationship Manager will conduct property visits, coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, and support clients throughout the entire transaction process, including documentation and follow-up. Responsibilities include maintaining client records, responding to inquiries, providing market insights, and ensuring a high level of client satisfaction and retention. The role also involves collaborating with the sales and operations teams to meet business targets and uphold Home Mantra’s standards of service and professionalism.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong client relationship skills, including active listening, empathy, and the ability to build trust with diverse clients.
* Candidates should possess sales and negotiation skills, with the ability to present property options clearly and close transactions effectively.
* Candidates should possess local market awareness and basic real estate knowledge, including property types, pricing trends, and regulatory considerations in Pune.
* Candidates should possess communication and presentation skills, with proficiency in clear spoken and written communication and the ability to explain complex information simply.
* Candidates should possess organizational and time management skills, including the ability to handle multiple client interactions, property visits, and documentation tasks efficiently.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, real estate, or a related field are preferred.
* Prior experience in real estate, financial services, or client-facing roles is an advantage, along with comfort working on-site and traveling within the Pune District.

title: WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager
description:
**We Offer**
The WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager combines two equally important responsibilities within KION's Enterprise Network service. Approximately 50% of the role governs the global WAN managed service, and approximately 50% coordinates service delivery and BAU operations across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI.
  
  
For WAN governance, the role monitors supplier delivery, contractual performance, service levels, lifecycle, risks, costs and improvement actions. The role prepares analysis, forecasts, recommendations and decision proposals for the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Budget accountability, cost-centre responsibility, contract ownership and final commercial decisions remain with the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Day-to-day operational coordination with the WAN managed service provider is performed by a designated WAN Operations Coordinator under the functional guidance of this role; overall WAN governance responsibility remains with this position.
  
  
For network service delivery, the role coordinates the shared operating model, queues, incidents, service requests, changes, problems, operational readiness and performance reporting. The role has no disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility for network engineers. Engineering capacity and line management remain with the responsible managers, while this role provides process coordination, prioritisation transparency and cross-domain escalation.
  
  
The role works closely with the Enterprise Network Service Owner, Lead Network Architect, network engineers, IT Service Management, regional IT teams, Procurement, Finance and external network providers.
  
  
**Tasks And Qualifications**

* WAN governance, roadmap and lifecycle - 15%
* Prepare and maintain the proposed WAN service roadmap in alignment with the Enterprise Network Service Owner and Lead Network Architect.
* Identify lifecycle, resilience, capacity, sourcing and technical-debt risks and prepare recommendations for accountable decision makers.
* Track approved governance decisions and improvement actions to completion.
* WAN supplier and contractual-performance governance - 15%
* Act as the primary operational governance interface for the WAN managed service provider, carriers and access providers.
* Monitor SLAs, KPIs, contractual obligations, potential service credits, risks and supplier commitments.
* Prepare evidence and recommendations for contract, renewal and commercial decisions owned by the Enterprise Network Service Owner.
* Lead supplier service reviews and escalate recurring underperformance, weak corrective actions and unresolved risks.
* WAN cost transparency, demand and transition assurance - 10%
* Prepare cost, consumption and forecast transparency for review and approval by the Enterprise Network Service Owner; the role has no budget or cost-centre accountability.
* Assess the WAN service, supplier, commercial and operational implications of approved demands.
* Coordinate provider estimates, service acceptance and transition requirements with the demand owner, Lead Network Architect and Enterprise Network Service Owner.
* Ensure operational acceptance covers documentation, monitoring, testing, support routes, supplier acceptance and handover.
* WAN performance, data and continual improvement - 10%
* Maintain WAN scorecards covering availability, incidents, capacity, resilience, change quality, supplier performance and cost transparency.
* Coordinate supplier follow-up after significant interruptions, including RCA quality and preventive actions.
* Maintain accurate governance artefacts and promote consistent data across ITSM, CMDB, monitoring, inventory and source-of-truth capabilities.
* Identify opportunities for automation, observability, data-quality improvement and reduced manual coordination.
* Enterprise Network operations coordination - 20%
* Coordinate the BAU operating model across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI without assuming disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility.
* Run queue reviews, service-health reviews and handover checkpoints; make ageing, blocked work and coverage gaps transparent.
* Coordinate operational priorities with line managers and engineering leads and escalate unresolved capacity conflicts to the Service Owner.
* Provide functional guidance to the designated WAN Operations Coordinator responsible for daily KION-provider coordination.
* Incident and service-request coordination - 15%
* Coordinate triage, ownership, progression and documentation for incidents and service requests in the shared Enterprise Network queue.
* Coordinate cross-domain and high-priority incidents, bringing together network, security, application, infrastructure and supplier teams.
* Ensure clear ownership, timely escalation, stakeholder communication and disciplined technical handovers; specialist teams retain technical resolution responsibility.
* Monitor ticket ageing, reassignments and documentation quality and drive corrective action where required.
* Change, problem and operational-readiness governance - 10%
* Coordinate operational risk reviews for significant or high-risk network changes, including production dependencies and rollback readiness.
* Drive follow-up of recurring problems, RCAs, known errors and preventive actions.
* Confirm that new or changed services enter BAU with monitoring, documentation, runbooks, support ownership, access and escalation routes in place.
* Operational performance and service improvement - 5%
* Report queue health, response and restoration performance, recurring incidents, backlog, monitoring coverage and handover quality.
* Maintain and improve SOPs, runbooks, escalation contacts, service maps and operational knowledge.
* Use operational trends to recommend improvements to resilience, automation, standards and training

Interfaces
  
  
**Internal**

* Secure Connectivity platform leadership, functional and team leads, and rotating operations engineers
* Enterprise and Network architecture; Cybersecurity and Information Security
* IT Service Management, e.g. Service Desk, (Major) Incident, Problem and Change
* Procurement, Legal, Finance/Controlling and Vendor Management
* Regional and onsite IT, business partners, programme and project managers
* Cloud, datacentre, workplace, decentralised infrastructure and application teams

**External**

* Telecommunications carriers and local access providers
* Managed network and security service providers
* Network technology vendors, integrators and professional-services partners
* Auditors and specialist advisers where required

title: Senior Manager - Client Servicing (Events background Mandatory) - Pune
description:
**Job Title: Senior Manager – Client Servicing**

**Location:**
Pune

**Experience:**
10-15 years in Experiential Management / Event Management

**Role Overview**

The
**Senior Manager – Client Servicing**
will act as the strategic bridge between our corporate clients and internal teams to deliver world-class brand activations in Pune region. You will deeply understand client brands, lead high-stakes pitch winning concept presentations, and orchestrate seamless end-to-end project execution while maintaining strict process adherence and quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Brand Strategy & Brief Understanding**

•
**Deconstruct Briefs:**
Deeply analyze client requirements, core brand identity, and task objectives to establish clear project directions.

•
**Market Awareness:**
Leverage robust brand knowledge and regional market trends to position Wizcraft as a cutting-edge industry leader.

**2. Client Relationship & Focus**

•
**Service Responsiveness:**
Act as the primary, agile point of contact, ensuring prompt

communication and exceptional client support.

•
**Relationship Building:**
Establish long-term trust with key regional corporate clients and stakeholders to unlock organic account growth.

**3. Pitching & Concept Creation**

•
**Strategic Ideation:**
Brainstorm and design experiential strategies tailored to diverse brand portfolios.

•
**Pitch-Winning Presentations:**
Build and present compelling, high-impact concept decks that secure new regional business.

**4. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Delegation**

•
**Internal Brief Translation:**
Clearly convert client needs into actionable briefs for creative, technical, and operational teams.

•
**Task Delegation:**
Allocate responsibilities across the internal team efficiently to maximize productivity.

**5. Project Management & Execution**

•
**End-to-End Planning:**
Lead project timelines, risk management, and overall resource allocation.

•
**Operational Cooperation:**
Work closely with creative and on-ground operations teams to seamlessly bring concepts to life.

•
**Quality & Timelines:**
Ensure all brand experiences are delivered flawlessly on time and meet Wizcraft's premium quality benchmarks.

**6. Process Adherence & Operations**

•
**Project Closure:**
Manage strict administrative oversight for timely project completions, operational debriefs, and reporting.

•
**Financial Discipline:**
Ensure prompt invoicing, payment tracking, and budget adherence to optimize project profitability.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

•
**Experience:**
10+ years in client servicing or account management within top-tier event management or experiential agencies.

•
**Competencies:**
Proven track record of winning pitches, excellent storytelling capabilities, strong command over live activation logistics, and a solid understanding of the Pune corporate market landscape.

title: Technical Account Manager (TAM)
description:
Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will work closely with our customers, build relationships with them, help them achieve their technical goals, and overcome technical challenges.The Technical Account Manager (TAM) serves as a trusted technical partner to customers, acting as the primary point of contact for technical guidance, system optimization, and issue coordination after implementation. The TAM works closely with customer System Administrators and internal teams to understand business processes, ensure effective system configuration, and help customers maximize value from the platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Named Technical Contact**

* Serve as the dedicated technical resource for assigned customer accounts
* Partner with customer System Administrators to understand business processes, workflows, and system configurations
* Maintain deep familiarity with each customer’s environment, priorities, and use cases55

**Product Expertise & Consultation**

* Act as a product expert, providing guidance, best practices, and technical consultation
* Translate customer business needs into system configuration and optimization recommendations
* Support customers in understanding platform capabilities, limitations, and tradeoffs

**Issue Facilitation & Support Oversight**

* Provide oversight and coordination for customer support tickets
* Own or directly manage highly technical or complex issues as needed
* Effectively escalate critical and urgent issues, partnering with Support, Engineering, and Product teams to drive resolution
* Analyze support trends and proactively address recurring issues

**Readiness & Enablement Management**

* Ensure customers are prepared for and leveraging new product features
* Conduct Release Readiness Reviews to prepare customers for upcoming releases, including testing, configuration changes, and process impacts
* Partner with customers to drive feature adoption aligned to their business goals

**Trusted Advisor & Relationship Management**

* Run a regular cadence of customer meetings to review:

+ Open workstreams and initiatives
+ Support ticket status and analysis
+ New questions and technical needs
+ Open and prioritized issues
+ Action items and next steps

* Serve as a trusted consultant, ensuring alignment between customer goals and platform usage
* Advocate for customer needs internally and provide feedback to Product and Engineering teams

**You will do well in this role if you…**

* become a trusted advisor to customers, hyper-focused on quality and successful adoption
* always strive to provide exceptional customer experience
* are technical-focused with analytical and problem-solving skills while able to describe technical configurations to non-technical audiences
* build positive relationships with peers while working remotely with others across geographies and cultures
* listen continuously, learning from others and leveraging input
* possess unquestionable integrity, credibility, and character proactively demonstrating high moral and ethical behavior
* constantly improve your own work methods
* commit to the sustainability/scalability of Legion solutions
* work well as a self-starter in a fluid work environment with limited resources
* are a career driven individual looking to grow in a fast paced startup

**Requirements and Qualifications**

* 3+ years Technical Account Management or other relevant experience such as implementing and configuring workforce management solutions
* Experience in managing multiple stakeholders and projects with competing priorities
* Strong root cause diagnostic capabilities to assess customer reported problems and determine whether it’s a software, configuration, or user error
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* Possess exceptional interpersonal and English communication skills including verbal, written presentation and listening
* Technical understanding of integration platforms such as Workato, Dell Boomi, Jitterbit,

SnapLogic (Workato preferred)5
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications and Skills**

* Workforce management (WFM) consulting and integration experience
* 3+ years Technical Account Management or other relevant experience such as implementing and configuring workforce management solutions
* Proven ability to manage changes for business growth minimizing disruption
* Experience in operating environments in retail, hospitality, restaurant or other industries to understand and identify labor challenges that Legion solves
* Exposure to agile software development leveraging toolsets (e.g. Jira, GitHub, Jenkins)

**ABOUT LEGION**
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.
  
  
Our award-winning AI-native workforce management platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric and proven to deliver 13x ROI. We help labor-intensive organizations maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously.
  
  
Legion has earned recognition for its innovation, including spots on the Inc. 5000 list, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, and awards for our AI technology. Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change.
  
  
If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
  
  
**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously.
  
  
Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and is designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is composed of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
  
  
For more information, visit https://legion.co
  
  
**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a hybrid employer in Bucharest, Romania, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.
  
  
We strive to make competitive offers, allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.
  
  
Benefits include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Health Benefits
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Parental Leave
* Equity
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly Lunch at Legion

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.
  
  
**DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION**
For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co
  
  
*Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.*
**How We Determine What We Pay**
*As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.*

title: Manager-Operations
description:

Allianz Services is where that legacy meets the future. 8,200+ people. Eight countries. Three continents. We deliver specialized services to clients within Allianz Group, powered by AI, advanced analytics, and a mindset that refuses to stand still. From core insurance operations to engineering and consulting services, we reimagine how insurance works. What truly sets us apart are our people and the trusted partnerships we build, anchored in our values of expertise, integrity, and empowerment. We don't support the business. We shape it.”
  
  
**Job Description :**
Manager Operations -US Life Insurance
  
  
**Location:**
Pune, India
  
  
**Work Model:**
Work from Office
  
  
**Shift:**
US Night Shift
  
  
**Function:**
Insurance Operations / Client Delivery

105457 | Operations | Management | Non-Executive | Allianz Services | Full-Time | Permanent

title: Careline Lead, Asia & METSA
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**
With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
  
  
We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
  
  
**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
  
  
We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
  
  
ABOUT ICE CREAM: Life Tastes Better with Ice Cream Once separated from Unilever, the The Magnum Ice Cream Company (TMICC) will become the world’s largest global Ice Cream Company, with over 100 years’ experience delivering a diverse range of indulgent, yet responsible, craft food experiences. We have 35 brands, including 3 one billion Euro brands (Magnum, Wall’s, Ben & Jerry’s), a strong presence in over 60 countries, generating annual revenue of €8 billion. All brands are driven to transform moments into memories through indulgent yet responsibly made and marketed products. We have a well-developed strategy to deliver growth and value creation which is clear on where to play and how to win. We turn the ordinary into the extraordinary by designing unique and innovative Ice Cream experiences that make life taste better, creating joyful experiences. In our Ice Cream business, we’re crafting the future through innovation and imaginative minds, creating unique products. We spark moments of happiness for people and within the communities where we operate. We are committed to developing and nurturing talent. You will have ample options for career growth and exploration. Your career development will be a priority for us, and we are dedicated to supporting your growth journey within the new company. ABOUT GBS: Global Business Solutions:   Global Business Solutions (GBS) is TMICC’s trusted transformation partner, delivering innovative and integrated solutions from design to delivery. We develop future-fit capability, expertise and technologically advanced solutions to unlock speed, simplicity and operational agility across TMICCs operations. This is your chance for a ‘once in a lifetime’ career experience, playing a part in the creation of a fully independent, new Ice Cream company and a greenfield GBS organization supporting Europe Supply Chain Finance Processes. Employees within GBS partner with multiple teams in countries across Europe ranging from Factories, Distribution Centers, Supply Chain Planning, Customer Services, Procurement. You will become part of the delivery service engine behind TMICC’s hero brands and will have the opportunity to implement new solutions and processes alongside an innovative tech stack that is been delivered as part of the separation from Unilever program. What you'll be responsible for Act as the primary point of contact between GBS Careline teams (Captive and/or 3PSP) and markets within the region (BU). Act as an additional layer of supervision of work performed by 3rd party vendor for daily services. Serve as the escalation point for operational risks, delays, or service failures, and coordinate crisis management, ensuring timely resolution and transparent communication. Ensure Careline operations consistently follow TMICC global standards, processes, tools, timelines, communications, validating consistent implementation across the region. Monitor and govern region-level Careline operations performance using dashboards and reports, ensuring service delivery meets agreed SLAs, KPIs, and quality standards. Identify trends, risks, and root causes of underperformance, drive corrective actions, and promote continuous improvement across the region. Support markets during transitions, onboarding, and operating model changes, ensuring awareness, readiness, and alignment between the operations and local market requirements. Hold accountability for region-level budget governance, including vendor cost tracking, volume forecasting alignment, and identification of cost optimization opportunities. Manage stakeholder relationships across internal teams (Marketing, Legal, Supply Chain, Quality) and external partners, ensuring alignment on priorities, timelines, and deliverables at the regional level. We're looking for someone who Practical experience in Consumer or Customer Engagement operations, with understanding of customer care processes, performance KPIs, and quality standards. Exposure to governance, coordination, or oversight roles within GBS, shared services, BPO, or complex multi market environment Team Manager experience in supervising team members (direct or 3rd party BPO). Ability to work across multiple countries or markets, supporting alignment with global standards, processes, and timelines. Experience supporting or coordinating transitions, operating model changes, or transformations, with a strong understanding of readiness, governance, and escalation. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to review performance dashboards, identify trends and risks, and drive follow up actions through stakeholders. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, combined with a high ownership mindset and confidence to challenge and escalate where required. What you'll get Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards Flexible ways of working Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work Time off to rest and recharge Ongoing learning and development opportunities Specific benefits vary by location
  
  
**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
  
  
**Additional Information**
The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Supervisor CASR
description:
About CleanHarbors Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $5.2 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim, who today remains the company’s Chairman and CEO. Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment. Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees. Our Vision To be recognized as the premier provider of environmental and industrial services
  
  
**Responsibilities**

Admin Team Leader Location: Pune Previous experience: 4+ years

* Assure our customers enjoy experience by working closely with other teams to smoothly transition onto their team

* Providing solutions to customer opportunities through inspections, evaluations, and customer service

* Assist in stakeholder management as an integral responsibility of this role
* Responsible for: meeting the defined KPI’s, deliverable timelines, quality check of all deliverables from GCC, conducting meetings and focus group discussions on improvements and implementation.

**Qualifications**
Required Skill Set:
  
  

* 1.5+ years of operations excellence with People Management experience (preferably in Sales or Customer Success/Customer Care field)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Must have worked with Cross Functional teams across the globe
* Must possess a global mindset and adaptability to different environments
* Must be Quality Oriented with a passion in process improvement and automation
* Must have excellent analytical/ problem solving inclination, proactive approach and accountability
* Experience leading and coaching teams, developing career paths and opportunities. Demonstrated ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously
* Attention to detail and able to maintain data confidentiality
* Proficiency in MS suites like Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, etc
* Basic qualification – Degree in any field

title: Senior Service Delivery Manager - Planning
description:
**Location: Pune & Bangalore**
**Life. Unlimited.**
At Smith+Nephew we design and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living.
  
  
Join us as a Senior Service Delivery Manager Planning in Pune and lead the global delivery of mission critical planning systems that power our Supply Chain operations. This is a role for someone who wants to influence how world class planning technology supports patient outcomes, shape a global service landscape and drive continuous improvement in a complex and fast evolving environment.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**

* Lead global service delivery for Kinaxis RapidResponse / Maestro planning applications across regions and time zones
* Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for all Kinaxis planning support and service‑related matters
* Own end‑to‑end ITIL‑based service operations, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Knowledge Management
* Ensure service delivery meets agreed SLAs, KPIs, and service excellence benchmarks
* Define, monitor, and continuously improve service performance metrics (SLA compliance, MTTR, MTTA, CSAT, etc.)
* Drive root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement to move from transactional support to value‑added services
* Oversee data integration monitoring and issue resolution across multiple ERP systems (e.g., SAP, AXAPTA)
* Partner closely with business leaders, relationship managers, super users, and CoE teams to align services with business priorities
* Lead planning enhancements and project initiatives supporting Global Supply Chain planning
* Manage AMS partners, vendors, contracts, and statements of work, including performance reviews and governance forums
* Own service budgets, cost control, and identify cost‑optimization opportunities without impacting service quality
* Provide regular service performance reporting to senior IT and business stakeholders
* Collaborate with IT and functional leaders to define service offerings and improve operational effectiveness

+ Promote a customer‑focused, collaborative, and inclusive culture aligned with organizational values

**What will you need to be Successful?**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field
* Master’s degree in Business Administration or IT Management (preferred)
* 10+ years of overall IT experience, with at least 5 years in a Service Delivery Manager role
* Mandatory experience working with an AMS provider‑based support model
* Proven experience supporting Kinaxis RapidResponse / Maestro in a global enterprise environment
* Experience with ERP integrations, ITSM tools, and project delivery in complex landscapes
* Prior experience in regulated industries (life sciences or medical devices preferred)
* Demonstrated experience managing global service delivery operations across regions
* Kinaxis Maestro Author or Administrator certification (highly preferred)
* ITIL certification (mandatory) Strong expertise in Kinaxis RapidResponse / Maestro, including administration, integrations, and data flows
* Solid understanding of end‑to‑end supply chain planning processes (S&OP, demand, supply, inventory)
* Hands‑on experience with ITIL v4 service management practices and KPI‑driven service delivery
* Proven capability in AMS service delivery models and SLA‑driven operations
* Strong vendor, contract, and supplier management skills
* Financial acumen, including budget management, cost control, and financial governance

title: Digital Customer Success Specialist
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
Digital Customer Success provides structured, scalable Customer Success engagement for customers outside dedicated one-to-one coverage. The function combines customer intelligence, proactive risk identification, digital engagement and cross-functional coordination to help customers realise value and enable account teams to take timely, informed action.
  
  
You will own the community and digital-engagement workstream, combining online community operations, structured customer outreach, content governance, customer-feedback enablement and engagement measurement. The role requires strong operational ownership, editorial judgement and disciplined stakeholder coordination.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Community platform ownership: Administer online customer community spaces, roles, permissions, onboarding, approvals, notifications, moderation and analytics.
* Community operations: Run operating cadences across multiple product communities and support new community launches.
* Content planning and publishing: Maintain content calendars and coordinate the sourcing, review, scheduling and publishing of value-led posts, polls, events, release information and webinar content.
* Stakeholder governance: Own recurring coordination with product and marketing stakeholders, including agendas, action tracking, approval routes and community roadmaps.
* Customer outreach: Execute structured customer introduction, invitation, re-engagement and information campaigns using validated contacts and account-owner alignment.
* VOC and NPS enablement: Coordinate pre-survey awareness, recipient alignment and follow-up inputs supporting customer-feedback programmes.
* Campaign operations: Manage shared mailboxes, communication templates, audience logic, response ownership and applicable opt-out or marketability controls.
* Community growth and advocacy: Increase qualified membership and participation and identify appropriate customer stories, testimonials and advocacy opportunities.
* Cross-functional coordination: Partner with account teams, Solution Consultants, Product Management, Product Marketing, IT and platform partners to remove dependencies.
* Measurement and continuity: Track membership, reach, publishing cadence, engagement and outreach response; maintain SOPs, access records and repositories.

What You'll Need
  
  

* Experience: 3–6 years in community management, digital customer engagement, customer marketing, Customer Success or comparable work.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Engineering or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Platform capability: Hands-on experience administering an online community or digital engagement platform.
* Content and communication: Strong professional writing, content curation and editorial judgement across posts, events, newsletters and customer communications.
* Campaign execution: Experience with structured email outreach, audience segmentation and basic communication-compliance concepts.
* Stakeholder management: Ability to manage multiple stakeholder groups, approval flows, calendars and commitments with disciplined follow-through.
* Measurement: Ability to track and explain community or outreach performance using practical engagement metrics.
* Operating discipline: Strong organisation across trackers, minutes, action logs, content calendars and document repositories.
* Community platforms: Experience with Mighty Networks, Higher Logic, Khoros or a comparable platform.
* Customer feedback: Experience supporting VOC, NPS or broader customer-experience programmes.

* Business systems: Familiarity with CRM or a Customer Success platform and B2B enterprise software.
