title: Associate Director Domain Consulting(Retail)
description:
**Job Description** 




**Ciklum** 
 is looking for an
 **Associate Director Domain Consulting** 
 to join our team full\-time in India.
 



 We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
 



**About The Role** 




 We are seeking a seasoned, high\-impact an Associate Director Domain Consulting to anchor and scale our Retail \& Consumer Goods (RCG) vertical. With 12–15 years of industry expertise, you will act as the core consultative bridge between our global clients business challenges and our advanced IT and Digital Engineering services. In this role, your primary responsibility will be up\-front business consulting, proactive discovery, and strategic advisory. You will lead high\-value presales engagements, shape proactive transformational pitches, and author industry\-specific solutions across Digital Experience, Merchandising, and E\-commerce ecosystems. You will partner closely with Regional Sales Leaders and Technical Solution Architects to accelerate pipeline conversion and position our firm as an elite digital transformation partner.
 



**Responsibilities** 



1. **Domain Consulting \& Advisory (50%)**


* Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the global designated authority on modern RCG workflows, driving the foundational business strategy across:



 Digital Experience: Personalization engines, loyalty frameworks, omnichannel customer journeys, and next\-generation smart\-store tech
 



 Merchandising: Inventory optimization, automated assortment planning, dynamic pricing strategies, and end\-to\-end supply chain visibility
 



 E\-commerce Ecosystems: Modern headless/composable commerce architecture, global marketplace integrations, and frictionless checkout optimization
 


* Discovery Workshops: Architect and lead consultative discovery sessions with enterprise\-tier prospective clients to unearth hidden operational pain points and map out actionable digital transformation roadmaps
* Strategic Client Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to prospective client executives, bridging the gap between their business pain points and our technical delivery capabilities long before an RFP is issued



**Presales, Bid Advisory \& Solutioning (35%)** 



* Own the Domain Story: Author end\-to\-end functional and business solutions for complex RFPs, RFIs, and high\-value proactive pitches within the RCG space
* Value Proposition Engineering: Translate traditional retail business challenges into cutting\-edge Digital Engineering, Cloud, Data, and AI solutions
* Deal Governance: Partner closely with Regional Bid Managers and Technical Architects to ensure final engineering designs map perfectly back to the client’s expected business value outcomes
* Defense \& Presentation: Lead orals and solution defense sessions with global prospect stakeholders (C\-level, VPs, Directors) to instill absolute confidence in our vertical capability



**Collateral \& Capability Building (15%)** 



* IP Development: Author forward\-looking white papers, case studies, point\-of\-view (POV) documents, and reusable retail\-specific capability frameworks
* Market Intelligence: Collaborate with the Enablement/Research team to analyze global retail trends, tech disruptions, and competitive landscapes to continuously optimize our market messaging
* Sample KRAs: Deal Win Ratio \& Conversion, Revenue Generation \& Pipeline Influence, Consulting Billability \& Utilization, Thought Leadership \& IP Creation, Solution Quality \& Stakeholder CSAT



**Requirements** 



* Overall Experience: 12–15 years of professional IT/Digital Services experience, with a minimum of 10\+ years dedicated strictly to Domain Consulting, Pre\-sales, \& Solutioning within the RCG domain
* Services Portfolio: Proven track record of winning large\-scale deals in Digital Engineering, Custom Application Development, Cloud Migrations, and Data/Analytics environments
* Domain Track Record: Demonstrable portfolio of shaping solutions across E\-commerce platforms (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe/Magento, Commercetools, or custom MACH setups), Unified Merchandising systems, and Digital CX platforms
* Core Competencies:
* Consultative Selling: Ability to pivot fluidly from a high\-level business strategy conversation with a retail Chief Marketing/Operating Officer to a technical alignment discussion with a Chief Architect
* Communication \& Presence: Exceptional verbal, written, and narrative storytelling skills. Ability to write clear, compelling proposal responses that avoid technical jargon where appropriate
* Collaborative Mindset: Experience working in a global matrixed environment, seamlessly orchestrating inputs from localized sales reps, technical leads, and shared enablement utilities
* Education:
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* An MBA or equivalent post\-graduate management degree from a tier\-1 institute is highly preferred



**What’s in it for you?** 



* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open\-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large\-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations



**About Us** 




 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
 



 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
 



**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!** 




 Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

title: Senior Implementation Consultant
description:
**Zycus** 
 is looking for an Senior Implementation Consultant with expertise in eProcurement implementation. The ideal candidate will have 6\-10 years of experience in end\-to\-end implementation of procurement software and a strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) or Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) solutions like SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Basware, Jaggaer, or similar platforms.
 



  





 In this role, you will lead complex, global implementations for Fortune 1000 enterprises, driving successful deployment, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. You will also play a key role in enabling AI\-driven procurement transformation, leveraging intelligent automation, analytics, and emerging technologies.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




  





 As a Senior Implementation Consultant, you will own the end\-to\-end implementation lifecycle of our procurement SaaS platform. You will work closely with clients, product teams, and technical stakeholders to deliver scalable, integrated, and intelligent procurement solutions.
 



 You will also contribute to embedding AI capabilities into procurement workflows, enhancing efficiency, decision\-making, and user experience.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Implementation \& Delivery
 



  




* Lead end\-to\-end implementation of procurement SaaS solutions for global clients.
* Gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into scalable solution designs.
* Configure and customize the platform to align with client\-specific procurement processes.
* Drive integration with ERP and third\-party systems using APIs and middleware.
* Manage and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring high\-quality deployments.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with high customer satisfaction.



  





 Client Engagement \& Enablement
 



  




* Act as a trusted advisor to clients on procurement transformation and best practices.
* Conduct training sessions, workshops, and enablement programs to drive adoption.
* Provide post\-go\-live support and continuous improvement recommendations.



  





 AI \& Digital Transformation Initiatives
 



  




* Collaborate with product and data teams to implement AI\-powered features such as:
* Intelligent invoice processing and automation
* Predictive spend analytics and insights
* Supplier risk scoring and recommendation engines
* Identify opportunities to embed AI/ML into procurement workflows to improve efficiency and decision\-making.
* Drive adoption of automation, chatbots, and AI assistants within procurement processes.
* Analyze client data to recommend data\-driven optimizations and process improvements.
* Contribute to defining AI use cases, solution design, and value realization frameworks.
* Stay current with advancements in AI, GenAI, and automation within procurement and enterprise SaaS.



  





 Collaboration \& Leadership
 



  




* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including Product, Engineering, and Project Management.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to knowledge sharing and best practices.
* Support pre\-sales activities, including solution demos and client workshops, where required.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





 Education
 



  




* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or a related field.



  





 Experience
 



  




* 6–10 years of experience in SaaS implementation, preferably in procurement or supply chain solutions.
* Strong expertise in S2P and P2P processes.
* Hands\-on experience with any one of these platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Jaggaer, Basware, or similar.
* Proven experience in system configuration, customization, and ERP integrations.
* Exposure to APIs, data integration, and cloud technologies.



  





 Preferred Skills
 


* Experience working with AI/ML\-enabled enterprise applications or automation tools.
* Understanding of data analytics, reporting, and visualization tools.
* Familiarity with Agile/Waterfall project methodologies.
* Strong problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced, global environment.



  





 Location: Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune
 



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work with leading global enterprises to drive digital and AI\-led procurement transformation.
* Be part of a fast\-growing SaaS organization at the forefront of AI innovation in procurement.
* Thrive in a collaborative, high\-impact, and innovation\-driven environment.
* Opportunity to shape next\-generation intelligent procurement solutions.

 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Technical Account Management (TAM) team provides a proactive and personalized support experience for customers that require a higher level of engagement. TAMs will act as the Support primary point of contact for the customer and also be their advocate within Support and other Workday internal teams.
   

  

 The TAM ensures business objectives and goals alignment within teams. They proactively identify opportunities to improve reliability and maintain availability of the Workday system, helping customers effectively manage their operations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Workday Support is looking for a dedicated, ambitious and self\-driven Technical Account Manager with a passion for customer relations. This role requires a self\-motivated professional with technical acumen that consistently brings a high level of commitment to customers and Workday teammates. The ideal candidate brings strong communication and project management skills as well as strong technical background and the ability to strategically and tactically navigate the challenges with large and complex customers.
   

  

 The Technical Account Manager will develop and maintain close relationships with a strategic group of implementing and production customers. The ideal candidate will coordinate and prioritize business critical cases/events and will be responsible for driving escalations and incidents for these customers, managing internal and external communications with stakeholders, including but not limited to C\-level executives.
   

  

**You will:**
* Work with Workday's largest strategic accounts to build positive relationships
* Prioritise multiple accounts simultaneously
* Act as a liaison between Operations, Professional Services, Development, Product Management and Customers to ensure understanding and alignment
* Become an authority in Workday's Architecture and leverage it on all engagements as needed
* Demonstrate proficiency in Workday products: HCM, Payroll, Financials
* Review upcoming customer events and planned production activities to identify potential problems, then plan and execute solutions
* Successfully engage with Senior Leadership, Technical and Functional staff to remove roadblocks, address delays and mitigate issues
* Own and drive escalated issues blocking production success
* Effectively use sound business judgment, risk avoidance and SME resources to coordinate team efforts to solve problems
* Carry out regular review of customer cases to identify trends
* Champion and advocate for customers with internal and external stakeholders
* Manage meaningful situations in a fast paced environment
* Chair roundtables to ensure close communication and relationship building with key stakeholders
* Serve on and actively participate in customer steering committee meetings
* Drive customer self\-sufficiency by ensuring their customers understand how to engage with the Workday Support organization and leverage tools
* Pilot new programs and drive continuous improvement initiatives for production customers
* Travel occasionally up to 25% of the time
* Participate in our 24x7 program


**About You**
**Basic Qualifications**
* BS or MS in a Technical Degree (ie. Computer Science, MIS) or equivalent technical work experience and acumen
* 7\+ years of experience in product support, customer success, account management or consulting for large, complex ERP, HCM, Financial, CRM or cloud computing system (SaaS preferred)
* 5\+ years of experience successfully implementing or managing Workday, Oracle, SAP, PeopleSoft, Ultimate Software, Kronos or similar projects at a senior or executive level


**Other Qualifications**
* Working experience with at least one of the following business areas: Human Resources, Payroll, Time Tracking, Recruiting, Financials
* Established history of successfully managing issues through resolution and escalation management at both the business owners and executive levels
* Demonstrated leadership skills and experience with high\-level stakeholders. Ability to engage at C\-Level
* An outstanding customer service record
* Team player with ability to engage across corporate functions (Managing Partners, Customer Support, Professional Services, Development and Product Management)
* Excellent verbal, presentation and written communication skills, including the ability to chair meetings or host webinars
* Ability to read, anticipate and assess high stress situations quickly
* Ability to deal with the stress related to project timeframes and competing priorities.
* Strong planning and organizational skills (project management experience is a must)
* Excellent analytical, problem solving, and multitasking skills
* Ability to work independently, adapt quickly, and maintain a positive attitude


 This position is based in the Workday Pune office. Candidates must be willing to relocate to Pune.
   

  

 Candidates will be expected to work
 **APJ shift** 
 hours to support our APJ Customers.
   

  

 Candidates will be expected to participate in our 24x7 program.
   

  

 Candidates will be expected to work from the office at least 50% of the time.
   

  

 Candidates need to be able to travel weekly for customer onsite visits and events up to 50% of the time.
   

  

 Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.
   

  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply

 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

* Possess a deep understanding of the Procure\-to\-Pay lifecycle and supplier management processes.
* Have experience administering corporate card programs, including Travel \& Entertainment (T\&E), Purchasing Cards (P\-Cards), and B2B payment solutions, with a strong understanding of card controls, policy compliance, expense management, and payment optimization strategies.
* Have excellent customer service skills, understand the customer journey, and advocate for process improvements that benefit both customers and operational teams.
* Work effectively across functions to drive resolution, maintain customer satisfaction, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. You turn problems into opportunities.
* Be skilled at explaining technical and process\-related issues succinctly and clearly.
* Have experience with ERP and expense management platforms such as Coupa, Oracle (R12/Fusion), Concur, or similar systems (preferred).
* Demonstrate strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, manage risk, and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders.

SmartQ is redefining how the world experiences food. As a next\-generation food\-tech innovator, we solve real operational challenges through empathy\-led insights and powerful technology. Our mission is clear: to elevate everyday dining into a seamless and meaningful experience.

With a bold vision to become the world’s largest B2B food\-tech company, we connect people through exceptional food experiences powered by advanced technology. Today, we proudly serve 400\+ global clients, including leaders like Google, HSBC, Amazon, and Wells Fargo.

You will coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams, monitor machine performance and inventory, and drive continuous improvements to support business growth.
 



  





 Do you possess all these skills and wish to make an impact in the world of food and technology? Join us now!

title: Staff Technical Account Manager
description:
What You'll Do
   

  

 The Staff Technical Account Manager is responsible is a critical member of Avalara’s support organization, responsible for managing technical tickets, ensuring timely resolution, and driving customer satisfaction for our Enterprise. Involving complex product and connector issues that cannot be fully resolved through frontline troubleshooting alone, while improving the speed, quality, and consistency of engineering engagement. This is an engineering\-aligned support talent that can reduce time to resolution, improve case quality, raise the standard of Jira submissions, and turn repeat issues into durable knowledge and process improvements. It also reflects Avalara’s broader need to embed AI into technical support in practical ways that improve investigation speed, communication quality, and team scalability. In addition to resolving complex issues, this role is expected to use AI in day\-to\-day work to accelerate research, strengthen technical analysis, improve case documentation, and identify opportunities to make technical support more effective and scalable over time.
   

  

 The business outcome this role enables is straightforward: better customer experience, faster and more reliable resolution of complex cases, better use of engineering capacity, stronger support scalability, and fewer repeat incidents over time. By combining technical judgment with thoughtful AI adoption, this role also helps Avalara improve how support work is performed, not just how individual cases are resolved.
   

  

**How This Role Elevates Avalara**
* This role raises the technical bar of Enterprise Support by bringing stronger investigation discipline, better case documentation, cleaner handoffs, more effective Jira creation, and clearer collaboration with Product and Engineering. It also improves the capability of the broader support organization by turning difficult cases into reusable knowledge, troubleshooting actions, and support\-ready guidance that reduces future rework.
* This role helps Avalara reduce unnecessary Jira volume, improve the quality of engineering escalations, and protect engineering capacity for the issues that truly require development effort. It also supports better operational performance through stronger SLA discipline, cleaner milestone adherence, faster TTR, and more predictable case outcomes.
* This role improves customer trust by ensuring that the most complex issues are handled with technical depth, clear communication, accurate diagnosis, and accountable resolution ownership. It also improves the long\-term customer experience by reducing repeat incidents and strengthening self\-service through better knowledge assets and preventative actions.
* Protect and increase Enterprise customer revenue and retention by resolving complex customer\-impacting issues quickly and accurately.
* For customers, the TAM provides a trusted technical partner who understands their environment, anticipates risk, and delivers clarity during high\-impact situations. This proactive, relationship\-driven approach increases platform reliability, improves customer experience, and drives long\-term success


**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
* Provide leadership and mentorship to TAMs – providing knowledge sessions, brown\-bag training and advanced troubleshooting of APIs and ERPs.
* Own a portfolio of Avalara’s Enterprise customers with premium support entitlement.
* Own complex support cases from assignment through verified resolution, especially where advanced troubleshooting, reproduction, deep product analysis, or engineering coordination is required.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis across ERP/CRM/eCommerce platforms (NetSuite, D365, SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Shopify, Workday, etc.).
* Diagnose customer issues across AvaTax, connectors, and related workflows by reproducing issues, gathering diagnostics, isolating scope, documenting findings, and confirming business impact.
* Determine when engineering involvement is warranted and ensure Jira tickets are necessary, complete, technically credible, and supported by strong due diligence before submission.
* Create, refine, and manage Jira tickets that clearly describe the issue, expected and actual behaviour, troubleshooting completed, reproduction detail, supporting evidence, and urgency.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to drive defect resolution, maintain momentum on linked development work, and keep customer cases moving while internal work is in progress.
* Maintain strong customer communication discipline by meeting milestone expectations, providing proactive updates, responding quickly to new customer messages, and keeping status and documentation audit ready.
* Improve support effectiveness beyond the individual case by completing troubleshooting of the issues and analysis on major or repeat issues and contributing knowledge articles, playbooks, or reusable troubleshooting guidance that reduce repeat volume.
* Contribute to High priority support or production\-support responsiveness where applicable by providing fast technical guidance, validating escalation paths, and helping the broader support organization make better decisions earlier in the case lifecycle.
* Act as a technical role model for quality, ownership, and judgment in how cases are investigated, escalated, documented, and resolved.
* Contribute to responsible AI adoption by using sound judgment, validating outputs, and ensuring that final recommendations, communications, and actions remain accurate and customer ready.
* Help embed AI into support ways of working by sharing effective use cases, improving repeatable practices, and supporting continuous improvement across the team.


**12\-Month Success Signals**
* Consistently meets or exceeds SLA targets and maintains high CSAT scores.
* Reduces complex escalation backlog and improves average resolution time.
* Contributes documented root\-cause fixes that decrease repeat incidents.
* Delivers measurable efficiency gains through AI\-assisted workflows (e.g., reduced case handling time, improved documentation speed).


 What You’ll Need To Be Successful
   

  

**At Avalara, this role is expected to be a bar raiser for Support Engineering, leveraging technical expertise, data\-driven insights, and AI\-enabled capabilities to elevate troubleshooting, accelerate issue resolution, and prevent recurring customer problems. They continuously improve support operations, knowledge management, and team effectiveness while delivering exceptional customer outcomes.**
* Raise the bar for the team. Provide guidance, improve execution quality, and leave cases, routing, and knowledge resources better than you found them.
* Own complex cases end to end. Drive the issue forward, clarify ambiguity, follow up proactively, and make sure cases do not stall waiting on others.
* Identify and drove resolution of recurring product defects, resulting in improved customer experience and reduced support volume.
* Consistently achieve high customer satisfaction scores through effective issue ownership, technical expertise, and proactive communication.
* Reduce critical issue resolution time to 5 days through structured root cause analysis and cross\-functional collaboration.


**AI Bar Raiser Expectations**
**This role is expected to be an AI Bar Raiser, applying AI in a deliberate and impactful way to improve how technical issues are diagnosed, resolved, and prevented, while elevating the team’s ability to use AI to drive meaningful gains in support efficiency, knowledge quality, technical troubleshooting, and customer outcomes.**
* Leverage AI\-powered tools to accelerate root cause analysis and reduce troubleshooting time for complex customer issues.
* Identify and implement new AI\-driven approaches to technical support (e.g., automated diagnostics, intelligent case triage, predictive risk identification) that go beyond current team practices
* Utilize Generative AI to create knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and customer\-facing documentation, improving knowledge accessibility and consistency
* Develop AI\-driven workflows that automated repetitive support tasks, increasing team productivity and reducing manual effort.
* Create AI\-powered prompt libraries and support playbooks that standardized troubleshooting approaches across the team.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to integrate AI\-driven customer feedback analysis into product improvement initiatives.
* Champion AI adoption across the support organization, driving measurable improvements in resolution efficiency and support quality.
* Use AI insights to prioritize critical customer issues based on business impact, severity, and historical trends.


**Qualifications A**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of proven experience in handling complex technical issues in SaaS, APIs, integrations, or similar environments, with strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
* Expert experience with ERP/CRM/eCommerce platforms: NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, SAP S/4 Hana, SageX, Salesforce, Magento, Oracle, Shopify, Workday, or similar systems is required
* Demonstrated proficiency in API and workflow analysis across ERP, e\-Commerce, and Marketplace platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with Engineering/Product teams and manage high\-quality escalation artifacts (e.g., Jira) with clear technical detail.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working in SLA\-driven support environments using tools such as Salesforce, Jira, and Confluence.
* Mandatory experience using AI tools and automation to improve support efficiency, diagnostics, communication quality, and scalability.


 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


 How We’ll Take Care Of You
   

  

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
   

  

 Inclusive culture and diversity
   

  

 Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
   

  

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
   

  

 We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
   

  

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

description:
**Position Details** 



* **Role:** 
 CCS Consultant / Implementation Officer (Client Conversion \& Implementation)

 Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai (3 days a week onsite and 2 days remote)

 Rotational Shifts

 7\+ Years of Core Financial Services Experience

 Custody Operations, Back\-Office Investment Accounting, Global Client Implementation, Transaction Management

 MCH, Advent Geneva, eHorizon, or equivalent accounting/custody engines

 Immediate to 30 Days Preferred



**Position Overview** 




 In this leadership role, you will take ownership of client conversion initiatives, onboarding plans, and operational deliverables for premier institutional accounting, custody, and insurance clients. Acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and project lead, you will bridge the gap between global clients, internal Centers of Excellence (COEs), and daily operations teams. You will drive the seamless migration of historical data, configure operating models, standardize accounting methodologies, oversee settlement/SWIFT workflows, and transition portfolios into business\-as\-usual (BAU) delivery mode.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Conversion \& Onboarding Leadership:** 
 Direct the planning and execution of onboarding roadmaps and conversion workstreams for custody, fund accounting, and insurance client portfolios.
* **Operating Model Alignment:** 
 Map operational workflows, identify and document processing methodology variances between legacy and target environments, and articulate these changes clearly to clients and internal stakeholders.
* **Accounting \& Custody Operations Oversight:** 
 Oversee complex custody workflows pre\- and post\-conversion, including trade capture, fails management, Standard Settlement Instructions (SSIs), corporate actions/asset servicing, cash allocations, and SWIFT message protocols (MT5xx / MT1xx / MT2xx).
* **Platform \& System Migration:** 
 Leverage deep functional expertise in platforms like
 **Geneva, MCH, and eHorizon** 
 to troubleshoot accounting exceptions, NAV discrepancies, and position breaks during parallel runs.
* **Process Optimization \& Governance:** 
 Assess operational efficiency, eliminate bottlenecks, design straight\-through processing improvements, and ensure strict compliance with risk\-mitigation controls.
* **Cross\-Functional \& COE Coordination:** 
 Partner with global Shared Services, COEs, Technology, and Client Service verticals to guarantee procedural accuracy and meet strict SLA deadlines.
* **Team Leadership \& Mentorship:** 
 Guide, train, and mentor conversion team members, conduct cross\-skilling sessions, oversee daily deliverables, and drive high performance across rotational shift windows.
* **Executive \& Risk Reporting:** 
 Track project milestones, maintain audit trails, and proactively escalate migration risks and timeline variances with proposed remediation strategies.



**Qualifications \& Sourcing Criteria** 




**Must\-Have:** 



* **Experience:** 
**10\+ years of active financial services experience** 
 specializing in Global Custody Operations, Fund Accounting Conversions, Investment Manager Servicing, or Back\-Office Transaction Management.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with a concentration in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Commerce, or Financial Technology.
* **Custody \& Settlement Mechanics:** 
 Expert understanding of global custody frameworks, clearing/settlement cycles, asset servicing, SSIs, cash reconciliation, and SWIFT message structures.
* **Complex Fund Knowledge:** 
 Deep domain exposure to offshore products, ETFs, hedged structures, derivatives, and Master\-Feeder setups.
* **Platform Proficiency:** 
 Hands\-on operational knowledge of accounting engines such as
 **Advent Geneva, MCH, eHorizon** 
 , or comparable tier\-1 systems.
* **Leadership \& Influence:** 
 Proven track record of leading teams, managing complex stakeholder relationships, and driving client implementations independently.
* **Shift Flexibility:** 
 Willingness to work in
 **rotational shifts** 
 from the
 **Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai** 
 office.



**Preferred / Desired:** 



* Industry\-recognized credentials such as Investment Banking Certifications, CFA, or CA/CPA.
* Demonstrated experience handling large\-scale fund migrations, ledger conversions, and parallel accounting runs.
* Outstanding analytical, negotiation, and executive communication skills.



**Why Join This Team?** 



* **Strategic Executive Visibility:** 
 Direct operational leadership over multi\-billion\-dollar global custody and accounting migrations.
* **Complex Asset Exposure:** 
 End\-to\-end engagement with sophisticated investment structures across international markets.
* **Dynamic Culture:** 
 Lead high\-performing teams within a collaborative, merit\-driven global client onboarding organization.



  





 If you are a seasoned financial operations and conversion leader ready to take on this Officer\-level position in Navi Mumbai, please reply with your updated resume, current location, current fixed CTC, expected CTC, and official notice period / last working date.

title: Partnerships Manager
description:
**About Virohan:** 




 Founded in 2018, by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja and Archit Jayaswal, Virohan is an education\-to\-industry partner, shaping the future of healthcare education. It enables India's top universities to deliver best\-in\-class undergraduate programs such as Optometry, MLT, Hospital Administration, OTT, MRIT, and more. Combining cutting\-edge technology, learner\-centric innovations, and strong industry partnerships, Virohan equips students with skills that go beyond degrees, preparing them
 



 for meaningful careers in healthcare. By 2030, Virohan aims to impact a million aspiring healthcare professionals and collaborate with over 100 universities across India to transform education and strengthen healthcare.
 



 We are backed by Blume Ventures, Mynavi Corporation and Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation and Artha Impact (Switzerland), Yunus Social Business (Germany), AngelList, and Keiretsu Forum, among others. Virohan operates at the intersection of education and Healthcare—two industries that have entered a new phase of rapid growth post\-pandemic. The time to make your mark in this space is now! We’re looking for entrepreneurs to join us in building the next unicorn.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for a
 **Manager/Senior Manager – Partnerships \& Alliances** 
 to lead strategic collaborations with top private universities across India.
 



 This is a senior, high\-impact role where you will engage directly with university leadership — Chancellors, Vice Chancellors, Vice Presidents, Directors, and Deans — to forge long\-term, high\-value partnerships. You will be responsible for driving alliances that enable universities to launch and scale Allied Health Science programs through revenue\-sharing models, ensuring both academic excellence and sustainable business growth.
 



 The ideal candidate is a confident relationship builder, a strategic thinker, and a trusted advisor capable of influencing senior stakeholders and translating opportunities into impactful collaborations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**A. Business Development \& Strategic Partnerships** 




 ● Identify and develop partnerships with top\-tier NAAC A, A\+, and A\+\+ private universities across India.
 



 ● Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential partners and manage the end\-to\-end partnership lifecycle — from outreach and engagement to closure and onboarding.
 



 ● Establish deep, trust\-based relationships with senior university leaders and decision\-makers.
 



 ● Lead partnership discussions and negotiations to secure win\-win agreements aligned with Virohan’s growth goals.
 



**B. Sector \& Market Expertise** 




 ● Develop an in\-depth understanding of Allied Health Sciences and the higher education ecosystem to position yourself as a domain expert.
 



 ● Stay up to date with UGC guidelines, regulatory frameworks, and emerging trends in healthcare education.
 



 ● Monitor market movements and competitive landscape to identify new partnership opportunities and strategic directions.
 



**C. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 ● Work closely with internal teams and partner universities to ensure seamless handover and successful program implementation.
 



 ● Collaborate with Partner Success and Academic teams to deliver exceptional outcomes for universities and students alike.
 



 ● Drive operational excellence and ensure partnerships deliver long\-term value.
 



  





**Experience \& Skills Requirements:** 




 ●
 **3\+ years of experience in B2B sales, strategic partnerships, or account management, preferably engaging with universities or large institutions.** 




 ● Proven success in managing C\-suite or senior academic relationships and closing large, consultative deals.
 



 ● Strong existing network within the higher education ecosystem is highly desirable.
 



 ● Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal abilities.
 



 ● Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
 



 ● Self\-driven, goal\-oriented, and capable of working independently while collaborating cross functionally.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 At Virohan, you’ll play a pivotal role in transforming India’s healthcare education landscape. You’ll work with passionate teams, visionary leaders, and a mission\-driven culture that rewards innovation, ownership, and real\-world impact.

 \- Channel mix

 \- Identify new market opportunities, customer segments and applications for orthopedic power systems.
   

 \- Develop category growth strategies for India and selected international markets.
   

 \- Track competitors, pricing, technology, product launches and market positioning.
   

 \- Identify gaps in Manman’s portfolio and recommend new products or product variants.
   

  

 B. Product Portfolio Management
   

  

 Own the complete Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio, including relevant:
   

  

 \- High\-speed drill systems
   

 \- Large\-bone systems
   

 \- Small\-bone systems
   

 \- Saw systems
   

 \- Oscillating/sagittal saws
   

 \- Reciprocating saws
   

 \- Shaver systems
   

 \- Endoscopic burr systems
   

 \- Attachments
   

 \- Handpieces
   

 \- Accessories
   

 \- Consumables
   

 \- Batteries and chargers
   

 \- Related service and AMC offerings
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Define product positioning and target customer for each product.
   

 \- Maintain the product portfolio and product lifecycle.
   

 \- Identify products requiring upgrades, replacement or discontinuation.
   

 \- Develop product roadmaps in coordination with R\&D and Engineering.
   

 \- Define product specifications based on market and clinical requirements.
   

 \- Gather voice\-of\-customer and surgeon feedback.
   

 \- Convert clinical requirements into clear product requirements for Engineering/R\&D.
   

  

 C. Product Development \& New Product Introduction
   

  

 \- Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for new products.
   

 \- Work with Engineering/R\&D on product development priorities.
   

 \- Coordinate prototype evaluation with surgeons and key opinion leaders.
   

 \- Organize clinical/user evaluations and product trials.
   

 \- Coordinate with Quality \& Regulatory for required documentation and approvals.
   

 \- Develop launch plans for new products.
   

 \- Establish product readiness gates before commercial launch.
   

 \- Coordinate first production, field trials and commercial release.
   

  

 D. Pricing \& Commercial Management
   

  

 \- Develop product pricing strategy based on:
   

 \- Manufacturing cost
   

 \- Landed cost
   

 \- Competitor pricing
   

 \- Clinical value
   

 \- Channel margins
   

 \- Customer segment
   

 \- Market positioning
   

 \- Recommend MRP, distributor/dealer pricing and institutional pricing.
   

 \- Monitor discounting and price realization.
   

 \- Develop tender and institutional pricing frameworks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve category gross margin.
   

 \- Monitor profitability by product, customer segment and channel.
   

  

 E. Sales Enablement
   

  

 Work closely with the Sales team to increase conversion and category penetration.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop sales presentations and product literature.
   

 \- Create product comparison sheets.
   

 \- Develop competitive battle cards.
   

 \- Conduct regular product training for sales teams and distributors.
   

 \- Train sales personnel on clinical applications and product positioning.
   

 \- Support major customer meetings, product demonstrations and evaluations.
   

 \- Participate in important tenders and institutional negotiations.
   

 \- Support the sales team in converting strategic accounts.
   

  

 F. Surgeon \& Key Opinion Leader Engagement
   

  

 Build strong relationships with orthopedic surgeons, hospitals and clinical experts.
   

  

 \- Identify and develop Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
   

 \- Conduct surgeon feedback programs.
   

 \- Organize product demonstrations and workshops.
   

 \- Coordinate product evaluations at hospitals.
   

 \- Gather structured feedback on product performance and clinical usability.
   

 \- Identify emerging surgical techniques and applications.
   

 \- Develop surgeon advisory panels where appropriate.
   

 \- Convert clinical feedback into product\-development priorities.
   

  

 G. Channel \& Market Development
   

  

 \- Develop strategies for direct, dealer and distributor channels.
   

 \- Identify and onboard suitable channel partners.
   

 \- Define territory\-wise category opportunities.
   

 \- Develop distributor sales targets and business plans.
   

 \- Monitor distributor inventory and secondary sales.
   

 \- Identify underpenetrated states and territories.
   

 \- Support international expansion of the category where required.
   

 \- Develop market\-entry plans for new countries.
   

  

 H. Marketing \& Category Communication
   

  

 Work with the Marketing team to build the Orthopedic Power Systems brand and category.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop category positioning and messaging.
   

 \- Plan product launches and campaigns.
   

 \- Create clinical and technical marketing content.
   

 \- Develop brochures, catalogues, videos and digital content.
   

 \- Support exhibitions, conferences and workshops.
   

 \- Plan surgeon engagement activities.
   

 \- Develop product demonstrations and educational material.
   

 \- Measure marketing effectiveness and lead conversion.
   

  

 I. Demand Planning \& Inventory
   

  

 Work closely with Sales, Production and Supply Chain to ensure the right product availability.
   

  

 \- Prepare monthly and annual demand forecasts.
   

 \- Translate sales plans into SKU\-level forecasts.
   

 \- Monitor inventory levels and ageing.
   

 \- Identify slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
   

 \- Coordinate production planning based on demand.
   

 \- Ensure availability of critical handpieces, attachments, batteries and consumables.
   

 \- Monitor forecast accuracy.
   

 \- Work towards improving inventory turns and working capital efficiency.
   

  

 J. Service \& Product Lifecycle Management
   

  

 Work closely with the Service team to improve customer experience and product lifecycle economics.
   

  

 \- Analyse field failures and service complaints.
   

 \- Identify recurring product issues.
   

 \- Coordinate corrective actions with Engineering and Quality.
   

 \- Monitor warranty claims.
   

 \- Develop AMC/service opportunities.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for refurbishment, upgrades and replacement sales.
   

 \- Track installed base and replacement cycles.
   

 \- Develop strategies for consumable and accessory attachment.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 The Category Manager will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes including:
   

  

 Commercial
   

  

 \- Category revenue growth
   

 \- Unit sales growth
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Average selling price
   

 \- Price realization
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- New customer acquisition
   

  

 Market
   

  

 \- Market share growth
   

 \- Number of active hospitals
   

 \- Number of active surgeons/users
   

 \- Geographic penetration
   

 \- Dealer/distributor productivity
   

  

 Product
   

  

 \- New product launches
   

 \- Launch success
   

 \- Product adoption
   

 \- Product lifecycle management
   

 \- Customer satisfaction
   

 \- Product quality feedback
   

  

 Channel
   

  

 \- Active distributors/dealers
   

 \- Distributor sales
   

 \- Secondary sales
   

 \- Dealer productivity
   

 \- Channel inventory
   

  

 Operational
   

  

 \- Forecast accuracy
   

 \- Inventory turns
   

 \- Slow\-moving inventory
   

 \- Product availability
   

 \- Warranty/service performance
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Cross\-Functional Responsibilities
   

  

 The Category Manager will work closely with:
   

  

 Function\| Primary Interaction
   

 Sales\| Revenue, pipeline, product conversion
   

 Marketing\| Category positioning and campaigns
   

 R\&D / Engineering\| Product development and roadmap
   

 Production\| Costing, capacity and product availability
   

 Quality \& Regulatory\| Compliance and product approvals
   

 Service\| Installed base, failures and lifecycle
   

 Supply Chain\| Forecasting and inventory
   

 Finance\| Pricing, margins and profitability
   

 Management\| Category strategy and business reviews
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Candidate Profile
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Preferred:
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
   

 \- MBA in Marketing, Product Management or Business Management will be an advantage.
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in:
   

  

 \- Orthopedic medical devices
   

 \- Surgical instruments
   

 \- Orthopedic power tools
   

 \- Neurosurgical power tools
   

 \- Surgical equipment
   

 \- Medical device product management
   

 \- Medical device sales/business development
   

  

 Candidates with strong experience in orthopedic power tools, surgical drills, saws, shavers or related capital equipment will be preferred.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical procedures and applications.
   

 \- Product management experience.
   

 \- Commercial and business\-development orientation.
   

 \- Strong analytical and market\-research capabilities.
   

 \- Understanding of medical\-device distribution.
   

 \- Pricing and margin management.
   

 \- Excellent presentation and communication skills.
   

 \- Ability to interact confidently with orthopedic surgeons.
   

 \- Ability to work with engineering and technical teams.
   

 \- Strong negotiation skills.
   

 \- Willingness to travel extensively.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Desired Personal Attributes
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be:
   

  

 \- Commercially aggressive but analytically driven
   

 \- Customer and surgeon focused
   

 \- Strong in ownership and execution
   

 \- Comfortable working with ambiguity
   

 \- Data driven
   

 \- Curious about technology
   

 \- Strong at cross\-functional coordination
   

 \- Able to understand both clinical and commercial requirements
   

 \- Comfortable presenting to senior management
   

 \- Willing to spend significant time in the field
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Within the first 12 months, the Category Manager should be able to:
   

  

 1\. Establish a clear strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 2\. Build a comprehensive competitor and market map.
   

 3\. Define the product portfolio and product roadmap.
   

 4\. Establish SKU\-level sales and demand forecasts.
   

 5\. Improve sales\-team product capability.
   

 6\. Build a structured surgeon/KOL engagement program.
   

 7\. Improve product conversion and market penetration.
   

 8\. Identify new product and portfolio opportunities.
   

 9\. Improve category gross margins and price realization.
   

 10\. Establish a measurable category review system with monthly business dashboards.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Role Philosophy
   

  

 This is not a conventional Product Manager role.
   

  

 The Category Manager is expected to operate as the business owner of Orthopedic Power Systems, with responsibility extending beyond product specifications into revenue, profitability, market development, customer adoption and portfolio growth.
   

  

 The role requires an individual who can move seamlessly between a surgeon discussion in the morning, a product\-development meeting in the afternoon and a commercial/business review with management in the evening.

title: Technical Success Manager
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160\+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in\-line cloud security platform.
   

  

 We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
   

  

**Role**
 We are looking for an experienced Technical Success Manager (TSM) to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Pune, reporting to the Manager, Technical Success Management in the Customer Success department. At Zscaler, our Customer Success Organization is a global, customer\-focused team dedicated to delivering high\-impact experiences and identifying innovative solutions. We leverage valuable data and research to provide expert, hands\-on support starting from the implementation phase and beyond, ensuring customers achieve their goals and leverage our technology to its fullest potential.
   

  

**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**
* Understand customer goals, challenges, and technical needs to align with Zscaler solutions and drive satisfaction
* Build relationships with stakeholders, conduct reviews, and identify growth opportunities
* Anticipate challenges, provide proactive recommendations, and mitigate risks
* Understand all Zscaler products and services and contribute to best practices for implementing Zscaler products in both internal and customer\-facing Knowledge Bases
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Support, and Product, to deliver a seamless customer experience


**Who You Are (Success Profile)**
* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high\-level strategy and hands\-on execution.
* You are a problem\-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser\-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high\-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.


**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**
* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI\-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* 5\+ years of experience in customer\-facing roles with a blend of technical expertise and account management
* Demonstrated experience with product feature implementations and best\-practice adoption
* Experience troubleshooting network issues utilizing tools such as Ping, Traceroute, and MTR across Linux, Unix, or FreeBSD operating systems
* Solid comprehension of core networking protocols including HTTP, SMTP, FTP, and DNS


**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**
* Experience utilizing AI\-powered customer success platforms or AIOps tools to analyze support sentiment, automate risk detection, and deliver predictive optimization recommendations
* Experience running discovery discussions, creating high\- and low\-level designs, and managing large\-scale enterprise deployments or migrations for cloud security technologies like SASE, SSE, and ZTNA
* In\-depth understanding of enterprise infrastructure, open\-source system administration, and authentication protocols such as SAML, LDAP, and OAuth


 At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:
   

  

* Various health plans
* Time off plans for vacation and sick time
* Parental leave options
* Retirement options
* Education reimbursement
* In\-office perks, and more!


 Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.
   

  

 By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.
   

  

 Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

description:
**Who are we?** 




 Checkmarx is the leader in application security and ensures that enterprises worldwide can secure their application development from code to cloud. Our consolidated platform and services address the needs of enterprises by improving security and reducing TCO, while simultaneously building trust between AppSec, developers, and CISOs. At Checkmarx, we believe it’s not just about
 *finding risk but* 
*remediating* 
 it across the entire application footprint and software supply chain with one seamless process for all relevant stakeholders.
 



 We are honored to serve more than 1,800 customers, which includes 40 percent of all Fortune 100 companies, including Siemens, Airbus, Salesforce, Stellantis, Adidas, Wal\-Mart, and Sanofi.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We're looking for a \*\*Value Realization Manager\*\* to join our Revenue Operations team. This is a newly created role focused on one clear mission: making sure the GTM technology we've invested in—Clari, Outreach, PG:AI, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and similar GTM platforms—actually delivers the business outcomes it was purchased for.
 



 You'll sit at the intersection of RevOps, Sales Enablement, and Vendor Management. Rather than just administering tools, you'll own the \*value\* they generate: adoption, ROI, workflow efficiency, and measurable impact on pipeline and revenue. If you've spent time as a customer success manager on the vendor side of GTM tech and are ready to apply that customer success discipline internally, this role is built for you.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own the end\-to\-end value realization strategy for our core GTM tech stack (Clari, Outreach, PG:AI, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and call recorder tools such as Kaia or Clari Copilot)
* Define and track adoption metrics, usage benchmarks, and ROI models for each platform; report regularly to RevOps and Sales leadership
* Partner with Sales, Sales Enablement, Business Application, and IT teams to ensure tools are configured, integrated, and used the way they were intended
* Identify underutilized features or workflows and drive targeted enablement to close the gap
* Act as the internal "CSM" for each vendor relationship—running regular business reviews, escalating issues, and holding vendors accountable to their own value promises
* Build and maintain a value realization scorecard/dashboard that ties tool usage to pipeline, forecast accuracy, and rep productivity outcomes
* Lead onboarding and change management for new tool rollouts or major feature releases
* Gather qualitative and quantitative feedback from sales reps and managers to continuously improve stack ROI
* Serve as the primary point of contact for renewal and expansion conversations, providing usage data and value evidence to inform commercial decisions



  





**Requirements** 



* 3\+ years of experience in customer success, revenue operations, sales enablement, or a related GTM function
* Direct hands\-on experience with at least 2 of the following: Call Recorder Tool, Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Strong communication and presentation skills—comfortable in front of sales reps, frontline managers, and executive leadership alike
* Strong analytical skills—comfortable building dashboards, interpreting usage data, and translating numbers into a business narrative
* Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to influence sales leaders and reps without direct authority



  





**Strongly Preferred:** 



* Prior experience as a \*\*Customer Success Manager at Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn\*\*—you know these tools from the vendor side and understand how to extract maximum value from them
* Familiarity with GTM tech stack architecture and how these tools integrate with each other and with Salesforce/HubSpot

title: Program Governance Manager – Customer Experience
description:
**Job Title: Program Governance Manager – Customer Experience** 




**Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)** 




**Permanent \- Full Time** 




  





**About Us:** 




 Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400\+ employees and 70,000\+ customers across 100\+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.
 



  





 Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.
 



  





 Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialised in technology.
 



  





**About The Role:** 




 The Program Governance Manager – Customer Experience is a relationship and governance role, not a target\-carrying operations role. You own the mechanism that makes the partnership work: the reporting, cadence, coordination, and health of the relationship. The delivery targets themselves (service levels, quality and cost) sit with the operational leaders. Your job is to make sure the partner always knows what is expected and where they stand, and that Cyncly leaders always have an accurate, current picture of the performance outputs of the BPO. Leaders such as our CX Domain Directors, SVP CX, CCO, and wider executive members.
 



  





 We work with a strategic outsourcing (BPO) partner to deliver customer support across multiple domains, product lines, and regions. This role is the single point of contact between Cyncly and that partner.
 



  





 You will keep a clear, consistent, and trusted view of how the relationship is performing, so that everyone on both sides always knows where things stand. You will stand the partnership up through transition and go\-live and then run the ongoing relationship day to day.
 



  





 The role is designed to expand as trust is earned: at the start, you stand up the mechanism, get reporting flowing, establish the governance cadence and make the transition land cleanly; as the relationship settles, you move from reactive to proactive by anticipating risks, championing change and building a genuine joint team; and in the mature relationship, you become a true partnership steward, keeping leadership sponsorship sharp and the relationship healthy and honest. The through\-line is a move from running the reporting to making the partnership succeed.
 



  





**Main Responsibilities:** 



* Act as the single point of contact for Cyncly's outsourcing partner across operational, reporting and relationship matters.
* Build and run the governance rhythm, including performance reporting, review meetings, quarterly business reviews, agendas, minutes, and action tracking.
* Produce clear, accurate performance reporting and maintain one consistent view of how the partnership is performing, creating a single trusted version rather than different stories across the business.
* Route and coordinate escalations to the right owners and drive them through to resolution.
* Coordinate capacity, workforce planning, and forecasting between partner and internal teams.
* Track risks, actions, issues and decisions, and surface emerging risks early.
* Lead Cyncly's side of the transition and go\-live, partnering closely with the provider's transition team, then carrying the relationship into a steady state.
* Champion continuous improvement and a genuine one\-team relationship built on trust and honest communication rather than adversarial vendor management.



  





**Required Skills and Experience:** 




**Experience** 



* Typically 8 to 14 years of experience in customer experience, contact center or BPO delivery, including experience managing or governing an outsourced engagement from the client side.
* Equivalent experience is valued; formal project, programme or partnership\-management credentials are welcomed where they support the role, but are not the primary requirement.
* Strong governance, project and relationship\-management discipline across cadence, reporting, risk tracking and stakeholder communication.
* Credibility and presence to hold governance with senior stakeholders on both sides, and to represent the business well.
* Solid grounding in contact\-centre operations, including workforce management, forecasting, customer satisfaction and quality, so you can coordinate meaningfully and interrogate the numbers.
* Comfort working with delivery data and reporting tools, and manipulating such data to be presented in a variety of formats to varying stakeholders of varying seniority
* Experience with Zendesk or a comparable ITSM/CCaaS customer service platform(s).
* Ability to create trust, maintain clarity, and build a one\-team relationship with an outsourcing partner while keeping accountability clear.
* Experience working in global teams \& managing stakeholders across geographies.



  





**Preferred but not required** 



* Experience standing up or transitioning outsourced engagement, with exposure to commercial negotiations and management.
* A project or programme management background, for example PMP certification.
* Experience across multiple regions and product areas.



  





**Working For Us:** 




 At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills \- and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.
 



  





 Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.
 



  





 We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone \- from every background \- to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.
 



  





 If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in \- come join us.

title: Principal Application Engineer
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Principal Application Engineer is the senior technical authority within the Litmus Customer Success team for the APAC region. This role provides technical leadership, oversight, and direction to the regional Application Engineering team, ensuring that customer implementations of Litmus Edge and Litmus Edge Manager are architecturally sound, delivered consistently, and aligned with customer outcomes and Litmus best practices.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will oversee the technical work of Application Engineers supporting proof\-of\-concept projects, pilots, production implementations, customer expansions, and complex support engagements. This person will establish regional technical priorities, review and approve solution designs, guide application engineers through complex technical decisions, and ensure that contracted technical responsibilities are delivered successfully.
   

  

 As a senior individual contributor and regional technical leader, the Principal Application Engineer will act as the escalation point for high\-risk implementations, critical customer issues, and complex architectural decisions. The role will also mentor Application Engineers, improve delivery standards, and develop reusable technical approaches that increase the quality, predictability, and scalability of customer delivery across APAC.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will partner closely with Customer Success leadership, Sales Engineers, Account Managers, Product Management, Development, partners, and the Litmus Support Desk. This role reports to the Manager, Customer Success Operations, with global reporting and technical alignment to the Director of Technical Delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Serve as the senior technical authority for Customer Success application engineering activities across the APAC region and provide technical direction, guidance, standards adherence and oversight to Application Engineers.
* Establish technical priorities for the regional Application Engineering team in alignment with customer commitments, commercial objectives, available capacity, implementation risk, and business value.
* Work with Customer Success leadership to assign technical resources and determine the appropriate level of engineering support for customer engagements.
* Balance immediate customer requirements with long\-term maintainability, product strategy, delivery scalability, and Litmus technical standards.
* Ensure that technical solutions demonstrate measurable business value and support customers’ operational, manufacturing, data, automation, and digital transformation objectives.
* Identify implementation dependencies, assumptions, risks, and technical gaps early in the customer lifecycle.
* Support Application Engineers during customer meetings when senior technical leadership, architecture expertise, or escalation management is required.
* Maintain consistency in how Litmus products are designed, configured, deployed, tested, and supported across the APAC region.
* Define when technical exceptions may be approved and document the risks, conditions, and mitigation requirements associated with those exceptions.
* Onboard, mentor and coach Application Engineers, helping them strengthen their architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, customer communication, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Serve as the regional escalation point for complex implementation issues, critical customer incidents, architecture concerns, and unresolved Level 2 support cases and provide advanced troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and remediation guidance for issues involving Litmus products, customer infrastructure, networks, integrations, data flows, and industrial systems.

****What You’ll Bring****

* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance customer urgency, contractual commitments, technical risk, team capacity, and strategic value.
* Ability to operate independently as a senior technical leader while collaborating effectively across regional and global teams.
* Willingness and ability to support customers and engineers across APAC time zones and to travel regionally when required.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Litmus Edge, Litmus Edge Manager, industrial data platforms, edge orchestration platforms, or similar technologies.
* Strong knowledge of industrial protocols and systems, including OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus, PLCs, SCADA, historians, MES, and industrial control environments.
* Experience designing highly available, secure, and scalable industrial edge architectures across multiple facilities or geographic regions.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity practices for operational technology, industrial networks, edge devices, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience supporting regulated, mission\-critical, or high\-availability customer environments.
* Experience with pre\-sales architecture, technical discovery, proposal approval, statement\-of\-work review, RFI/RFP responses, and commercial scope validation.

* Experience contributing to product roadmaps, design reviews, beta programs, technical validation, or release\-readiness processes.
* Experience developing technical standards, reference architectures, implementation methodologies, and reusable engineering assets.
* Relevant certifications in cloud architecture, Kubernetes, networking, cybersecurity, industrial automation, or solution architecture.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, automation, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


**Measures of Success**

* Successful delivery of strategic proof\-of\-concept and production engagements.

* Timeliness and quality of regional technical decisions and approvals.

 APAC

description:

 ͏
